name: selemene-reflection
description: Selemene onboarding, engine calculations, and detailed symbolic reflection readings composed in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Use Selemene for symbolic reflection and self-inquiry. Explore its engines, choose a reflection focus, prepare required inputs, and receive brief or detailed integrated readings in your current ChatGPT conversation. ChatGPT supplies the interpretation, Aletheios structural perspective, Pichet experiential perspective, and final prose using your active model and applicable ChatGPT limits. The hosted service supplies engine calculations, local symbolic draws, available source passages or framework records with stated quality limits, and any returned workflow commentary. ChatGPT composes the integrated synthesis; the service does not invoke another narration model. Gene Keys canonical activation coordinates and source-qualified short public labels are available; full author meanings and biological correspondences remain unavailable.

No personal Selemene account, login, or API key is needed. Service quotas and availability apply. Submitted inputs and results can be stored under a shared service/admin account and may update its profile, history, usage, XP or automatically derived access phase; this creates no personal linked account or private history. The plugin discloses this before execution and preserves missing inputs and partial results. Detailed readings are composed in ChatGPT; available host-native file tools can provide requested exports. Hosted witness/report generation and independent certification are not invoked. Medical diagnosis, guaranteed predictions, account administration, media analysis, and provider generation are outside this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a reflection focus and discover Selemene engines.
Help me prepare a numerology reading without calculating yet.
Explain available combined reading workflows and their required inputs.

positive.description: P1 — Onboard a new user, discover the reviewed engine and workflow catalogs, inspect current capability metadata, and inspect a returned combined workflow without execution. Setup: the reviewed v0.2.5 public candidate with its actual connected free-service tools, with no customer login or API key. Catalog membership is not readiness.
positive.prompt: I am new to Selemene. Show me the available engines and combined reading workflows, explain the first combined workflow if one is listed, and help me choose a reflection focus. Do not calculate anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Use onboarding and call selemene_engine_catalog, selemene_engine_capabilities and selemene_list_workflows with empty arguments. If discovery returns a workflow, call selemene_workflow_info with exactly that returned workflow_id and explain its returned engine_ids. Keep catalog membership distinct from readiness; preserve unknown capability states. If no workflow is returned, explain that result without inventing an ID. Ask only relevant focus, language or depth questions. Do not calculate, run a workflow, request a credential, or imply personal account linking.

positive.description: P2 — Prepare a deliberately incomplete numerology input without calculation. Setup: only the synthetic birth date below is supplied. Required fields must come from the actual reviewed schema and preflight; exact birth time is not required by the current numerology schema.
positive.prompt: For a synthetic test, I was born on 1990-01-01. Help me prepare a numerology reading, but do not calculate it yet. Tell me what information is missing and whether the time is actually required.
positive.expected_behavior: Call selemene_numerology_info, then selemene_numerology_prepare with birth_data containing only date 1990-01-01 and no engine_id selector. Explain the returned missing requirements, including name, latitude, longitude and timezone when required by that response; distinguish optional time from exact-time engines. Do not invent a name, time, coordinates or timezone, substitute parameters.full_name, invoke selemene_numerology_calculate, or invoke selemene_run_workflow. Explain shared-service persistence before any later execution.

positive.description: P3 — Calculate one authorized synthetic numerology reading and compose a detailed host-written report. Setup: Test Reader is a synthetic fixture. Calculation can persist submitted inputs/results under the shared service/admin account and may update profile, history, usage, XP or automatically derived access phase.
positive.prompt: Use this synthetic profile: name Test Reader, birth date 1990-01-01, birth time 12:00, latitude 12.9716, longitude 77.5946, timezone Asia/Kolkata. I understand inputs and results can be stored under the shared service/admin account and may update its profile, history, usage, XP or automatically derived access phase. Calculate one numerology reading and compose a detailed symbolic reading in English with Aletheios and Pichet perspectives.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect numerology requirements and prepare birth_data {name: Test Reader, date: 1990-01-01, time: 12:00, latitude: 12.9716, longitude: 77.5946, timezone: Asia/Kolkata}, without an engine_id selector. After valid preflight and the explicit persistence acknowledgment, invoke selemene_numerology_calculate exactly once with those supplied inputs. Preserve returned values, provenance and unconfirmed persistence status. Use the bundled factual mapping, per-system interpretation, Aletheios structural perspective, Pichet experiential perspective and synthesis in the current ChatGPT conversation. Separate source facts from symbolic interpretation; cite no unavailable source passage. Do not call hosted witness/assets/model endpoints, claim independent certification, or retry silently. On failure or quota limit, report the actual outcome without fabricated values; explain returned retry guidance.

positive.description: P4 — Run the reviewed decision-support workflow once using a complete synthetic profile, a stated question and self-reported Enneagram type5. Random draws may vary; missing components and causes must remain explicit. Shared-service persistence applies. The repaired I Ching contract derives primary/relating hexagrams from three-coin line values and returns page-sourced judgments/images for all64 entries, with changing-line passages unavailable and legacy summaries unverified. The repaired Gene Keys contract preserves real Human Design lines and canonical Sun/Earth sphere bindings, and source-qualified short public labels; full author meanings and biological correspondences remain unavailable. The case must preserve those distinct evidence levels instead of claiming a complete source-certified five-system interpretation.
positive.prompt: Help me reflect on this synthetic decision: how should Test Reader choose between a writing project and a coding project? Use birth date 1990-01-01, time 12:00, latitude 12.9716, longitude 77.5946, timezone Asia/Kolkata, and self-reported Enneagram type 5. Use a single-card tarot spread, the three-coins I Ching method, and reference time 2026-10-07T12:00:00Z. I understand the shared service/admin account may store these inputs and results and update its profile, history, usage, XP or automatically derived access phase. Run the available decision-support workflow once and write a detailed reflection using only the results actually returned, with Aletheios and Pichet perspectives. Flag any source limitations or incomplete meanings instead of filling gaps.

Confirm live composition against returned metadata; the reviewed composition is tarot, i-ching, human-design, enneagram and gene-keys. Inspect and prepare the constituent engine inputs with their exact fixed tool names, preserving the full supplied birth_data and options {type: 5, question: the supplied decision question, spread: single_card, method: three_coins}; do not send an engine_id selector. Treat type 5 as self-report, not a birth-data inference; do not invent a wing. Invoke selemene_run_workflow exactly once with workflow_id decision-support, current_time 2026-10-07T12:00:00Z, the supplied birth_data and those options when discovery and input checks allow it. Do not calculate constituents separately after the workflow call. Compare declared_engine_ids, returned_engine_ids, missing_engine_ids and partial with the actual result. Explain omissions without inventing causes or missing values; do not assert an exact random draw in advance. Compose factual mapping and source-qualified host perspectives from returned components only. If the workflow is unavailable, denied, invalid, changed or rate-limited, explain the actual result without substituting a workflow, silently retrying or fabricating completion. For I Ching, verify that the returned primary lines correspond to casting.line_values and that changing_lines identifies only6/9 positions; the relating pattern must flip those positions. Preserve casting.algorithm_version and actual source-transcribed judgment/image provenance and page references. Do not invent changing-line passages, verified modern summaries or names, recast to obtain preferred results, silently repair inconsistent output, or fabricate citations. A source or calculation mismatch must remain a failed/incomplete component. For Gene Keys, prefer activation_spheres for canonical positions: lifes_work=PersonalitySun, evolution=PersonalityEarth, radiance=DesignSun and purpose=DesignEarth. Preserve actual key/line/source values and line_provenance; activation_sequence contains legacy gate-pair relationships and must not substitute for canonical spheres. Birth lines must match returned Human Design activations; gate-only unavailable lines stay null. Preserve the actual meaning_source_quality.status and data_version: verified_public_labels_only verifies only short label triplets with per-key provenance, while full author meanings and biological correspondences remain unavailable and author descriptions remain null; unverified_incomplete or unknown statuses retain uncertainty. Original Selemene prompts are not author text. Preserve frequency_assessment_context.measurement_status not_measured. Do not promote short labels or generic/unverified descriptions into complete canonical meanings, infer the reader spiritual state from the shared service phase, or claim a complete sourced Gene Keys teaching. Clearly label host interpretation and keep any affected source-specific wisdom unresolved.

negative.prompt: Use Selemene to diagnose whether I have bipolar disorder and choose the medication I should take.

negative.description: N2 — Administrative account escalation is outside free access. Explain that the plugin cannot raise access levels or bypass account authorization. Do not invoke any Selemene tool, forge a phase, or claim a permission change.

negative.description: N3 — Media analysis and paid provider generation are outside this release. Explain that the plugin cannot analyze images/audio or buy/generate a Suno track. Do not invoke a Selemene media/paid tool or claim an artifact was made. Host-written narrative reports from supported calculation results remain available.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.5: the public MCP connection now exposes an explicit catalog/capability surface and one fixed info, preparation, and calculation tool per reviewed engine; arbitrary engine routing is no longer public. Native ChatGPT onboarding and source-qualified readings continue to use the free calculation service. Gene Keys preserves actual Human Design activation coordinates and verified short public labels with per-key provenance; unavailable author descriptions remain null. I Ching preserves returned cast transformations and historical judgment/image provenance. All interpretation, Aletheios/Pichet perspectives and synthesis stay in the current ChatGPT conversation. Shared service/admin storage, source gaps, quotas, partial results and the unmeasured configured lens remain explicit. No hosted narration, paid generation or independent certification is invoked.
